scope: Bounded real-device prototype acceptance; no production scope substitution.

prior_proof.reused: Cable-free loopback import/export and that experiment restoration, not UI pairing/current document/origin delivery.
Retained-PDF source-sized conversion and full PDF retention, not live tablet integration.

cases.action: Open native global Pi Ink entry, perform explicit pairing to a trusted setup-provisioned server, and inspect associated synthetic folder identities.
cases.required_observation: Owner sees intended server identity and real stock folder association; versions/hashes recorded. Repeated entry selection stays open, sidebar closure updates width, Back closes fully.

cases.action: Dispatch an approved synthetic source over authenticated LAN after USB disconnect, import it, and locate/open it through the stock library.
cases.required_observation: Actual stock documentUUID and folderUUID recorded with server/job/request/source identity and source dimensions. Do not infer imported UUID from the older fixed synthetic UUID.

cases.action: Draw, erase, undo, zoom and save using only the stock editor while the native Pi Ink foldout integration is present.
cases.required_observation: Owner reports pen latency, palm handling and toolbar interference; no assumed quality pass.

cases.action: Open Pi Ink native foldout above TOC, switch between two approved bound synthetic documents, then a designated unassociated synthetic document.
cases.required_observation: Server/connection/submission status follow current document; unassociated state never chooses a default unrelated job. Compact native layout works in tested orientations.

cases.action: Save/close without Send; reopen and explicitly Send; when out-of-source marks exist, exercise explicit clipping consent.
cases.required_observation: Pending originating request remains pending after Save/Close; actual exported pen marks produce a source-sized PNG only for that request; distinguish local save/server acceptance/agent delivery. Retain full PDF and editable stock work.

cases.action: Inspect four source edges, normal display scaling/zoom, and supported orientation changes, then compare returned PNG dimensions and marked pixel regions.
cases.required_observation: No stretching, viewport substitution or silent clipping; visible marks survive source-window conversion and owner can edit original stock annotations.

cases.action: Attempt stale/current-document mismatches and wrong-server/request submissions. Cancel a separate job and send its late result.
cases.required_observation: No result crosses document/server/request identities; cancellation remains terminal. Alternate-server Send omitted unless separately chosen.

cases.action: Record exact tested boundary, owner observations, unresolved limits and approved restoration/removal outcomes.
cases.required_observation: Historical evidence and unknown old state preserved; production remains blocked until all current acceptance gates and review pass. Cleanup0038 is not retried.

cases.action: During approved activation and integrated use, verify loopback-only stock HTTP binding and certificate-verified authenticated client transport.
cases.required_observation: No stock Wi-Fi/wildcard listener or generic LAN forwarding endpoint. Reuse0014 feasibility; this checks final deployed configuration safety.

cases.action: Complete the cable-free originating-request round trip and record actual supported activation/restoration behavior.
cases.required_observation: Only approved restart/lifecycle operations run. Untested sleep/reboot/firmware-update/reactivation cases stay explicitly unverified; no firmware upgrade to manufacture evidence.

safety.unknown_state: Preserve partial0026 and all unproven process/file state.
safety.tablet_boundary: Separate exact approval must name installation/repair preflight, payload hashes, owned paths, restart count, synthetic documents and restoration before any tablet connection or operation.
